The inverse limit of probability vectors is governed by the difference eigenvalue 1-2/q_k, giving a point for divergent reciprocal sums and a segment with exactly two extremes for convergent sums. Exact finite checks of recurrence and matrices passed; infinitary assertions follow from the proof.

value.rationale: A naturally parameterized 2026 family was previously known only to have some minimal non-uniquely ergodic examples. The exact iff criterion produces a concrete sharp switch between strict ergodicity and exactly two ergodic probabilities with the same uniquely ergodic Toeplitz base, and computes every invariant probability and its tower observations. Both regimes occur for elementary q sequences; the result is a structural measure classification rather than a routine finite check.
